ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES — MOCK EXAM #6
====

GRADE: PP2
SUBJECT: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 0 °C
   B. 50 °C
   C. 37 °C
   D. 100 °C

2. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. watt (W)
   B. pascal (Pa)
   C. joule (J)
   D. newton (N)

3. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Toileting PRACTICES? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Toileting PRACTICES.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Toileting PRACTICES.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Toileting PRACTICES.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Toileting PRACTICES.

4. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   B. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   C. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   D. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio

5. Which practice best shows correct science when studying PRACTICES? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for PRACTICES.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on PRACTICES.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about PRACTICES.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to PRACTICES.

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Myself ENVIRONMENT? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Myself ENVIRONMENT.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Myself ENVIRONMENT.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Myself ENVIRONMENT.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Myself ENVIRONMENT.

7. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Heating until a solid melts
   B. A chemical reaction forming ash
   C. Movement of water only across a membrane
   D. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Interpersonal ENVIRONMENT be able to;? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Interpersonal ENVIRONMENT be able to;.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Interpersonal ENVIRONMENT be able to;.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Interpersonal ENVIRONMENT be able to;.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Interpersonal ENVIRONMENT be able to;.

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Our Home? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Our Home.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Our Home.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Our Home.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Our Home.

10. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Tertiary consumers
   B. Primary consumers only
   C. Producers
   D. Decomposers only

11. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Paper burning to ash
   B. Iron rusting
   C. Milk souring
   D. Ice melting to water

12. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Removing all vegetation
   B. Burning crop residue every week
   C. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   D. Overgrazing continuously

13. Which practice best shows correct science when studying People found at home? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for People found at home.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to People found at home.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on People found at home.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about People found at home.

14. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Glucose and oxygen
   B. Nitrogen gas only
   C. Only water vapour
   D. Only carbon dioxide

15. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. A mixture of two liquids
   B. Any white crystal used in cooking
   C. Any substance that conducts electricity
   D. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means

16. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Care PRACTICES? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Care PRACTICES.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Care PRACTICES.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Care PRACTICES.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Care PRACTICES.

17. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Care for PRACTICES be able to;? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Care for PRACTICES be able to;.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Care for PRACTICES be able to;.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Care for PRACTICES be able to;.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Care for PRACTICES be able to;.

18. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Neighbourhood ENVIRONMENT? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Neighbourhood ENVIRONMENT.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Neighbourhood ENVIRONMENT.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Neighbourhood ENVIRONMENT.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Neighbourhood ENVIRONMENT.

19. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Our ENVIRONMENT? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Our ENVIRONMENT.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Our ENVIRONMENT.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Our ENVIRONMENT.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Our ENVIRONMENT.

20. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Food/ PRACTICES? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Food/ PRACTICES.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Food/ PRACTICES.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Food/ PRACTICES.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Food/ PRACTICES.

21. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Dressing ENVIRONMENT? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Dressing ENVIRONMENT.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Dressing ENVIRONMENT.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Dressing ENVIRONMENT.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Dressing ENVIRONMENT.

22. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   B. Water always increases oxygen
   C. Petrol fires have no fuel
   D. Water removes heat too quickly

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
23. In three clear sentences, explain Care For and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

24. In three clear sentences, explain Safety In and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

25. In three clear sentences, explain Myself ENVIRONMENT and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

27. In three clear sentences, explain Our Home and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

28. In three clear sentences, explain People found at home and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

29. In three clear sentences, explain Interpersonal ENVIRONMENT be able to; and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

30. In three clear sentences, explain Neighbourhood ENVIRONMENT and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
